name: Pulse Cage
source:
An anxious young girl in a small community comes to realize that she's being stalked by a mysterious admirer. On a journey to find herself (and not the person her family has molded her into), she soon finds out that a video exposing her in a new light has been sent to her friend's phone. She breaks out of her parents customs, after others begin to see her in a different way. In a desperate act, not knowing where else to look, she tries to find herself in other people as she grows closer to them. Holding tightly to the idea that she can be different, she opens herself up to the 'real world' that's been hidden from her, as she challenges herself to be ambitious and outgoing. Too much exposure makes her feel threatened and afraid, with no place to hide. Eventually, she chooses who she wants to be and only lets her body be controlled by its own pulse.

[Edited from [url=http://renai.us/game/pulse-cage-ep1]Ren'ai archive[/url]]
translation:
在一个小社区里，一名焦虑的年轻女孩意识到自己正被神秘仰慕者跟踪。她踏上寻找真正自我的旅程，而不是成为家人塑造的那个人；很快，她发现一段令自己焕然一新的影片已经被发送到朋友的手机上。

当其他人开始以不同眼光看待她时，她挣脱了父母为她制定的生活规则。可随着她与他人越来越亲近，她又绝望地发现自己无处寻找真正的自我。她相信自己能够与众不同，于是向隐藏的“现实世界”敞开心扉，逼迫自己变得雄心勃勃、外向。过度暴露令她感到威胁与恐惧，让她无处藏身。最终，她选择成为自己想要的模样，只让身体由自己的脉搏支配。

[编辑自[url=http://renai.us/game/pulse-cage-ep1]仁爱档案[/url]]
